User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the SELISE-ITO Portal, authenticated via an external system (e.g., Firebase). This entity stores application-specific user data rather than authentication credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The email address of the user, typically provided by the external authentication system.

displayName.description: The display name of the user, typically provided by the external authentication system.

role.description: The user's role in the portal.

needsPasswordChange.description: Flag indicating if the user is required to change their password on next login.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created in the portal.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account information was last updated in the portal.

GitHubIssue.title: GitHubIssue
GitHubIssue.description: Represents an issue (ticket) fetched from a GitHub repository, stored for display and analysis within the SELISE-ITO Portal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GitHubIssue entity.

githubIssueNumber.description: The public issue number from GitHub.

title.description: The title of the GitHub issue.

description.description: The full description or body text of the GitHub issue.

status.description: The current state of the issue (e.g., 'OPEN', 'CLOSED').

reporterUsername.description: The GitHub username of the issue's author.

assigneeUsernames.description: An array of GitHub usernames currently assigned to this issue.

closedBy.description: The GitHub username of the person who closed the ticket.

labelNames.description: An array of labels applied to this issue on GitHub.

url.description: The URL to the GitHub issue on github.com.

githubCreatedAt.description: Timestamp when the issue was created on GitHub.

githubUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when the issue was last updated on GitHub.

lastFetchedAt.description: Timestamp of when this record was last synced.

latestCommentBody.description: The body of the most recent comment.

latestCommentAuthor.description: The author of the most recent comment.

latestCommentAt.description: The timestamp of the most recent comment.

contentType.description: Type of GitHub item (Issue or PullRequest).

definition.description: Stores application-specific profile data for each user.
Shared enterprise issues synced from GitHub Project 181.
